Google Ads case study

A recommendation that didn't require more budget.

QT_Pmax_TopProducts

The campaign was delivering 463% ROAS but spending only 57% of its approved $24/day budget. Google marked it “Limited by target.”

184%
284%
400%
463%
550%
Recommendation

Lower Target ROAS from 550% to 400% so the already-approved budget can deliver more freely, then observe CPA, ROAS and spend for 3-5 days before any next move.

Reporting system

Data is only useful when it leads to a decision.

01 · DataWhat happened?

ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, purchase volume, frequency, watch time, engagement and store activity.

02 · ValidationIs the trend real?

Compare periods, check daily performance and separate one-day noise from sustained change.

03 · MeaningWhy does it matter?

Translate platform metrics into business context - creative, audience, spend, inventory or customer journey.

04 · ActionWhat next?

Recommend, hold, test or monitor - with a review point and guardrail already defined.
